environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EC2 in a public subnet with direct internet access. SMTP relay is Amazon SES configured in the same region. The application has outbound connectivity to SES SMTP endpoint (email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:587) with no egress filtering. Security groups allow all outbound traffic. No email content filtering or rate limiting is applied at the SES level beyond standard SES sending quotas.

config.network: Public subnet, IGW attached, security group allows all egress
config.smtp: Amazon SES SMTP endpoint, production access granted, no content filters
config.s3_access: Direct S3 API access via public endpoint
